subject: Lisa Kingsley School Committee Candidacy
overview: School Committee candidate Lisa Kingsley discussed her background in special education, her local community involvement, and her professional qualifications for the office.

items.title: Candidate Interview with Nathan Kingsley
items.summary: Lisa Kingsley outlined her transition to Medford, her career as an educator and school principal, and her volunteer work in the community to explain her motivation for running for the Medford School Committee.
